runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before jingling through Lakeside Park.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: Key race-day details for the 2026 Pell City Rotary Club Jingle Bell race morning.

items.label: Start area
items.detail: Race morning is based at Lakeside Park in Pell City, AL 35128.

items.label: Start times
items.detail: The 5K and 10K start at 8:00 AM CST; the 1 Mile Fun Run starts at 9:30 AM CST.

items.label: Course note
items.detail: The 5K and 10K repeat the 2025 courses and remain certified, with Course Number AL25014JE listed.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.detail: The race-day schedule lists registration and packet pickup from 7:00 to 7:45 AM before the opening ceremony and race start.

items.label: Included items
items.detail: Registration includes a race T-shirt, swag bag, and post-race refreshments, with November 29 as the guarantee deadline for T-shirt size and swag bag.

items.label: Pets and strollers
items.detail: The race notes ask pet owners to follow Pell City Animal Ordinance and Lakeside Park rules, keep pets on a leash, clean up after them, and have stroller participants start from the back because the course includes mixed surfaces.

story.title: A Jingle Bell morning for runners, families, teams, and Santa at Lakeside Park.
paragraphs: The Pell City Rotary Club Jingle Bell Run returns to Lakeside Park on Saturday, December 12, 2026 with 5K and 10K races plus a 1-mile Fun Run/Walk.
Race morning includes certified returning courses, cash prizes for top finishers, age-group medals, best-dressed awards, post-race refreshments, and a visit from Santa Claus from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM.
The team participation contest is also back: the team with the most registered participants receives a donation to the organization or charity of its choice.

faqs.question: Where is the 2026 race held?
faqs.answer: The 2026 race is held at Lakeside Park in Pell City, AL 35128.

faqs.question: What events are offered?
faqs.answer: Race morning includes the 5K Run, 10K Run, and 1 Mile Fun Run.

faqs.question: Are the 5K and 10K certified?
faqs.answer: Both courses repeat the 2025 courses and remain certified, with Course Number AL25014JE listed.

faqs.question: What is included with registration?
faqs.answer: Registration includes a race T-shirt, swag bag, and post-race refreshments. Register by November 29 to guarantee a T-shirt size and swag bag.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed?
faqs.answer: The race notes say pets are welcome if owners follow the Pell City Animal Ordinance and Lakeside Park Rules, keep pets on a leash, clean up after them, and remain responsible for their pet's actions.

faqs.question: Is the race stroller-friendly?
faqs.answer: The course includes asphalt running paths, roadways, grass, and a wooden bridge, which may not be ideal for strollers; stroller participants are asked to keep children with them and start from the back of the starting line.

faqs.question: What is the refund or transfer policy?
faqs.answer: Registration fees are non-refundable and transfers to another person are not permitted.
